guard: a once spawn's task ends its seat, every way the seat ends first settles the task, the seat takes no other turn, admission refuses what cannot carry a once task, and a connector's retirement proof gates the debt
why: S1 and S2 keep the seat running after its task yielded or reached its deadline: the helper this
feature exists to end. S3 lets a run hand a once seat a second turn. S4 admits a connector that
cannot be woken for the task, which then sits until its deadline. S5 leaves a task whose seat
was despawned open, with nothing left to end it. S6 leaves a seat that never joined running with
nothing to do. S7 clears the debt without the connector's proof that the seat's launched
processes are gone. S8 stops a seat that never joined only after its spawn's terminal is
published, so a stalled publish leaves it running. S9 drops a deadline whose terminal write was
refused, and S10 leaves that seat running past its deadline. S11 settles a never-served task's
debt at the readiness verdict, before the seat's exit and its connector's proof.

mutations.name: S1 a yield no longer stops the seat
mutations.expectRed: the seat is gone: its process exited and its slot was freed

mutations.name: S2 the deadline no longer stops the seat
mutations.find:
if (p.once) this.endOnceSeat(p, "turn-deadline");
      else await clearGoalIndex(gw.ctx, p.ref);
mutations.expectRed: ...and the seat is gone at its deadline

mutations.name: S3 a once seat accepts a second turn
mutations.expectRed: a second turn to a once seat is refused

mutations.name: S4 a connector without the relay is admitted
mutations.expectRed: a connector without the turn relay is refused, with its own reason

mutations.name: S5 the proved exit no longer cancels the task
mutations.expectRed: a despawn ends it: the task is cancelled `despawned` at the proved exit

mutations.name: S6 a seat that never joined is left running
mutations.expectRed: ...and the seat is stopped, never left running with nothing to do

mutations.name: S7 the debt clears without the connector's proof
mutations.find: const retired = owed.retire === undefined ? undefined : await this.retireOnceSeat(owed.retire);
mutations.replace: const retired = undefined as { discard(): Promise<void> } | undefined;
mutations.expectRed: a refused proof keeps the debt

mutations.name: S8 the readiness stop waits for the spawn's terminal
mutations.expectRed: a seat that never joins is stopped while its spawn's terminal cannot be published

mutations.name: S9 a refused deadline write is not written again
mutations.expectRed: ...and the deadline terminal is written again while the manager runs

mutations.name: S10 a refused deadline write leaves the seat running
mutations.expectRed: a refused deadline write still stops the seat at its deadline

mutations.name: S11 a readiness cancel clears the debt before the seat exits
mutations.expectRed: a seat that never joins: its task is cancelled at once, and its debt is kept while its process still runs
